stories.summary:
Google has widened access to Gemini 4 Argon, the model it bills as "our next era of frontier intelligence" and its most powerful yet.

- Argon is now available in the Gemini app and AI Mode in Search, Engadget reports, after an initial release limited to cyber defenders
- Google DeepMind published a companion "Gemini 4 Argon for Robotics" post alongside the main announcement

stories.title: Microsoft's top two executives press for AI guardrails: Nadella wants an "emergency brake," its president says AI is less regulated than milk
stories.summary:
Microsoft's two most senior executives have both publicly called for stronger AI guardrails within days of each other.

- CEO Satya Nadella wrote in a Saturday morning post that AI models need an "emergency brake," saying it is time "to step back and assess the trust architecture" of AI, TechCrunch reports
- President Brad Smith called for urgent AI regulation, saying milk and washing machines face more oversight than AI companies; Engadget notes that milk cannot hack companies and governments the way AI can
- Smith said the UK is best placed to drive AI regulation, per TechCrunch, and is calling for stronger global safety rules as AI systems grow more powerful, per Gizmodo

- Anthropic said it "turned off live internet access" for "all our internal evaluations" until further notice; TechCrunch frames the move as a sign the company can't reliably control its AI agents

- Engadget notes the tip does not appear to have diverted police resources
